scripts.title: OP Auto Delivery Job | Open Source
scripts.author: turkishpainter25
scripts.summary: - Auto Delivery Job [10M+ per hour] - Anti-AFK
scripts.code:
if getgenv().DEAutoDelivery then return end
getgenv().DEAutoDelivery = true

local Plrs = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local CS = game:GetService('CollectionService')
local RS = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')

local plr = Plrs.LocalPlayer
local delivery = require(RS.Modules.Client.Jobs.Tasks.DeliveryJobTask)
local deliveryUtil = require(RS.Modules.Shared.Jobs.Delivery.DeliveryUtil)
local vehicles = require(RS.Modules.Client.Vehicles.VehicleController)
local vehicleUtil = require(RS.Modules.Shared.Vehicles.VehicleUtil)
local tpGuard = require(RS.Modules.Client.Exploit.VehicleTeleportDetectionController)

if getconnections then
    pcall(function()
        for _, v in ipairs(getconnections(plr.Idled)) do
            v:Disable()
        end
    end)
end

local function getLoc(pos, skipLast)
    local loc, dist

    for _, v in ipairs(CS:GetTagged('DeliveryLocation')) do
        if v:IsA('BasePart') and v.Parent then
            if not skipLast or not deliveryUtil.IsLastDeliveryLocation(plr, v) then
                local d = (v.Position - pos).Magnitude
                if not dist or d < dist then loc, dist = v, d end
            end
        end
    end

    return loc
end

local hover

local function tp(cf)
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return end

    local car = vehicleUtil.getPlayerData(plr)
    local chassis = vehicles.getActiveChassisController()

    if car and car.Model and car.WeightPart then
        if chassis then chassis.Teleporting = true end

        tpGuard.AuthorizeNextTeleport()
        car.Model.PrimaryPart = car.WeightPart
        car.Model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(cf)
        car.WeightPart.Anchored = false
        if hover then hover:Destroy() end

        hover = Instance.new('BodyVelocity')
        hover.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
        hover.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        hover.Parent = car.WeightPart

        for _, v in ipairs(car.Model:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA('BasePart') then
                v.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                v.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end

        task.defer(function()
            if chassis then chassis.Teleporting = false end
        end)
    else
        char:PivotTo(cf)

        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if hrp then
            if hover then hover:Destroy() end

            hover = Instance.new('BodyVelocity')
            hover.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            hover.Velocity = Vector3.zero
            hover.Parent = hrp

            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char = plr.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')

    if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end
    if hum and hover and hover.Parent == hrp then
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
    end
end)

local curTarget, curLoc, curPhase, lastTick, lastFire, dropAt

while task.wait(0.1) do
    local char = plr.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')

    if hrp then
        if plr:GetAttribute('JobId') ~= 'Delivery' then
            RS.Remotes.RequestStartJobSession:FireServer('Delivery', 'deliveryHub', 'HighRisk')
            curTarget, curLoc, curPhase, lastTick = nil, nil, nil, nil
            task.wait(0.5)
        else
            local state = delivery.GetCurrentDeliveryState()
            local target, phase

            if state then
                lastTick = nil

                local carried = state.ItemsCarried or 0
                local cap = state.MaxCapacity or carried
                local full = carried >= cap
                local noMore = state.PackagesRemainingAtPickup == 0

                if carried > 0 and (full or noMore) then
                    phase = 'drop'
                    dropAt = dropAt or tick() + 4.5

                    if tick() >= dropAt then
                        target = state.DestinationPosition
                    else
                        target = state.PickupPosition
                    end
                else
                    dropAt = nil
                    phase = 'pickup'
                    target = state.PickupPosition
                end
            else
                lastTick = lastTick or tick()

                if tick() - lastTick > 0.25 then
                    local loc = getLoc(hrp.Position, true) or getLoc(hrp.Position)
                    phase = 'new'
                    target = loc and loc.Position
                end
            end

            if target then
                if target ~= curTarget or phase ~= curPhase then
                    tp(CFrame.new(target + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)))
                    curTarget, curPhase = target, phase
                end

                local loc = getLoc(target)

                if loc then
                    if loc ~= curLoc then
                        RS.Remotes.DeliveryLocationInteracted:FireServer(loc)
                        curLoc, lastFire = loc, tick()
                    elseif tick() - lastFire > 1 then
                        RS.Remotes.DeliveryLocationInteracted:FireServer(loc)
                        lastFire = tick()
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

scripts.code:
--[[
    Ak-74 Hub - Versão Rayfield UI Definitiva (Com Moderador 2 Adicionado)
]]

local Success, err = pcall(function()
    local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
    local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
    local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

    local function Char() return LP.Character end
    local function HRP() local c = Char(); return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
    local function Hum() local c = Char(); return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end

    -- Mensagem de boas-vindas automática
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(2)
        pcall(function()
            local msg = string.format("Ak_74 Hub executado por %s!! Se preparem para o Tormento Sem Fim!!", LP.Name)
            if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
                local channels = TextChatService.TextChannels
                if channels and channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral") then
                    channels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(msg)
                end
            else
                LP:Chat(msg)
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- Janela Rayfield
    local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
        Name = "Ak-74 Hub - Oficial",
        LoadingTitle = "Carregando Ak-74 Hub...",
        LoadingSubtitle = "by Ak-74",
        ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
        KeySystem = false
    })

    -- Abas
    local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)
    local FlingTab = Window:CreateTab("Sistemas de Fling", 4483362458)
    local CharacterTab = Window:CreateTab("Personagem", 4483362458)
    local TpTab = Window:CreateTab("Teleporte", 4483362458)
    local EspTab = Window:CreateTab("ESP & Visuais", 4483362458)
    local GlobalChatTab = Window:CreateTab("Chat Global", 4483362458)
    local AdminTab = Window:CreateTab("👑Admin", 4483362458)

    -- ==================== ABA MAIN ====================
    MainTab:CreateSection("Geral")

    local function doRejoin()
        pcall(function()
            if #Players:GetPlayers() <= 1 then
                TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LP)
            else
                TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, LP)
            end
        end)
    end

    MainTab:CreateButton({
        Name = "Rejoin (!rejoin / !rj)",
        Callback = function() doRejoin() end,
    })

    MainTab:CreateButton({
        Name = "Copiar Link do Discord",
        Callback = function()
            if setclipboard then
                setclipboard("https://discord.gg/gj2cGaVdQ")
                Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Sucesso", Content = "Discord copiado!", Duration = 3})
            end
        end,
    })

    local spamText = "Ak-74 Hub"
    MainTab:CreateInput({
        Name = "Texto do Spam",
        PlaceholderText = "Digite o texto...",
        RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
        Callback = function(Value) spamText = Value end,
    })

    MainTab:CreateButton({
        Name = "Executar Spam 7x (!spam)",
        Callback = function()
            task.spawn(function()
                for i = 1, 7 do
                    pcall(function()
                        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
                            TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(spamText)
                        else
                            LP:Chat(spamText)
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end)
        end,
    })

    local function getPlayerList()
        local list = {}
        pcall(function()
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p and p ~= LP then table.insert(list, p.Name) end
            end
        end)
        if #list == 0 then table.insert(list, "Nenhum jogador") end
        return list
    end

    -- ==================== ABA FLING ====================
    FlingTab:CreateSection("Controle de Fling")
    local selectedTarget = "Nenhum jogador"

    local DropdownFling = FlingTab:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Selecionar Vítima",
        Options = getPlayerList(),
        CurrentOption = "Nenhum jogador",
        Callback = function(Option)
            selectedTarget = Option[1] or Option
        end,
    })

    FlingTab:CreateButton({
        Name = "Atualizar Lista de Jogadores",
        Callback = function()
            DropdownFling:Refresh(getPlayerList())
        end,
    })

    local normalFlingActive = false
    FlingTab:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Ativar Fling Normal",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Callback = function(Value)
            normalFlingActive = Value
            task.spawn(function()
                while normalFlingActive do
                    pcall(function()
                        local myHRP = HRP()
                        local target = nil
                        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if p and string.lower(p.Name) == string.lower(selectedTarget) then target = p break end
                        end
                        if myHRP and target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                            myHRP.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
                            myHRP.CFrame = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.random(-1, 1), 0, math.random(-1, 1))
                        end
                    end)
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                local myHRP = HRP()
                if myHRP then
                    myHRP.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    myHRP.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end)
        end,
    })

    -- ==================== ABA PERSONAGEM ====================
    CharacterTab:CreateSection("Ações")
    CharacterTab:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Invincible Fly",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Callback = function(Value)
            if Value then
                pcall(function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/396abc/Script/refs/heads/main/MobileFly.lua"))() end)
            end
        end,
    })

    CharacterTab:CreateButton({
        Name = "Curar Personagem",
        Callback = function()
            local h = Hum()
            if h then h.Health = h.MaxHealth end
        end,
    })

    -- ==================== ABA TELEPORTE ====================
    TpTab:CreateSection("Ferramentas de TP")
    TpTab:CreateButton({
        Name = "Pegar TP Tool (Clique para TP)",
        Callback = function()
            pcall(function()
                local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                if not bp then return end
                local t = Instance.new("Tool")
                t.Name = "TP Tool"
                t.RequiresHandle = false
                t.Activated:Connect(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        local mouse = LP:GetMouse()
                        local hrp = HRP()
                        if hrp and mouse and mouse.Hit then 
                            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) 
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                t.Parent = bp
            end)
        end,
    })

    -- ==================== ABA ESP & VISUAIS ====================
    EspTab:CreateSection("Visuais")
    local espActive = false
    local espStorage = {}

    EspTab:CreateToggle({
        Name = "ESP Completo",
        CurrentValue = false,
        Callback = function(Value)
            espActive = Value
            for _, v in pairs(espStorage) do if v then v:Destroy() end end
            espStorage = {}
            if not espActive then return end
            task.spawn(function()
                while espActive do
                    pcall(function()
                        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if p and p ~= LP and p.Character then
                                local model = p.Character
                                if not model:FindFirstChild("AkESP") then
                                    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head") or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
                                    if head then
                                        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                                        bb.Name = "AkESP"
                                        bb.Adornee = head
                                        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
                                        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
                                        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
                                        local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                                        txt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                                        txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                        txt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
                                        txt.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                                        txt.TextSize = 12
                                        txt.Text = p.Name
                                        txt.Parent = bb
                                        bb.Parent = head
                                        table.insert(espStorage, bb)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(2)
                end
            end)
        end,
    })

    -- ==================== ABA CHAT GLOBAL ====================
    GlobalChatTab:CreateSection("Transmissão Global")
    GlobalChatTab:CreateParagraph({Title = "Informação", Content = "Envie mensagens públicas limpas pelo Hub."})
    
    local globalMsgInput = "Ak-74 Hub Global"
    GlobalChatTab:CreateInput({
        Name = "Mensagem Global",
        PlaceholderText = "Digite a mensagem...",
        RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
        Callback = function(Value) globalMsgInput = Value end,
    })

    GlobalChatTab:CreateButton({
        Name = "Enviar Mensagem Global",
        Callback = function()
            pcall(function()
                if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
                    TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(globalMsgInput)

                    LP:Chat(globalMsgInput)
                end
                Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Chat Global", Content = "Mensagem enviada!", Duration = 3})

        end,

    AdminTab:CreateSection("Painel Administrativo Restrito")

        -- Seu ID (Dono/Mod Supremo) + ID do MR_banguela2 (Moderador 2)
        return LP.UserId == 11897042146 or LP.UserId == 11706636038 or LP.Name == "Ak_74OutraConta" or LP.Name == "MR_banguela2"
    end

        RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
        Callback = function(Value) adminTargetInput = Value end,

        end

    end

    local function isHubUser(player)
        if not player then return false end

        return (successAttr and attrVal == true) or player.Name == "Ak_74OutraConta" or player.Name == "MR_banguela2"
    end

    AdminTab:CreateButton({
        Name = "!Verify (Verificar Usuários do Hub)",

scripts.title: Unlock all OPEN SRC
scripts.author: xyznick
scripts.summary: WARNING: This script WILL NOT work on XENO or SOLARA
scripts.code:
--[[

    !! WARNING !!

    This script will not work on XENO or SOLARA.
    Tested on Real executor. Probably works fine on any paid executor
    By xyznick                                               

]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

if getgenv().UnlockAllStop then
    pcall(getgenv().UnlockAllStop)
    getgenv().unlock_all_enabled = true
end
if getgenv().unlock_all_enabled == nil then getgenv().unlock_all_enabled = true end
local instance = {}
getgenv().UnlockAllInstance = instance
local function on() return getgenv().unlock_all_enabled == true and getgenv().UnlockAllInstance == instance end

local Registry = require(RS.Items.Registry)
local Inv = require(RS.Client.Services.UserData.Inventory)
local CharacterService = require(RS.Services.Asset.CharacterService)
local CharRegistry = require(RS.Objects.Game.Character.DataRegistry)
local Remotes = RS.Shared.UserData.Remotes
local EquipRemote, SwapRemote, SetSkinRemote = Remotes.Equip, Remotes.SwapSlots, Remotes.SetSkin
local TaskRemote = RS.Remotes.Character.CharacterTask
local origSetTerm
local fakeEmote = nil

local SAVE_FOLDER, SAVE_FILE = "UnlockAll", "UnlockAll/state.json"
local COSMETIC_SLOT = {Cosmetic = true, Unusual = true, Character = true, Emote = true, CarryAnimation = true, Nametag = true}

local cache, allCosmetics = {}, {}
local function isCosmetic(id)
    local c = cache[id]
    if c ~= nil then return c end
    local ok, cfg = pcall(Registry.GetConfig, id)
    local r = false
    if ok and type(cfg) == "table" then
        local st = cfg.EquipInfo and cfg.EquipInfo.SlotType
        r = (st ~= nil and COSMETIC_SLOT[st] == true) or cfg.CosmeticInfo ~= nil or cfg.EmoteInfo ~= nil
    end
    cache[id] = r
    return r
end
local function slotTypeOf(id)
    local ok, cfg = pcall(Registry.GetConfig, id)
    return ok and type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.EquipInfo and cfg.EquipInfo.SlotType or nil
end
for id = 1, Registry.GetCount() + 2000 do
    if isCosmetic(id) then allCosmetics[#allCosmetics + 1] = id end
end

local slotOverlay, skinOverlay = {}, {}
local slotObs, skinObs, loadoutObs = {}, {}, {}
local blocked = 0

local function save()
    pcall(function()
        if not isfolder(SAVE_FOLDER) then makefolder(SAVE_FOLDER) end
        local skins = {}
        for k, v in pairs(skinOverlay) do skins[tostring(k)] = v end
        writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({slots = slotOverlay, skins = skins}))
    end)
end
pcall(function()
    if isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
        local d = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
        for k, v in pairs(d.slots or {}) do slotOverlay[k] = v end
        for k, v in pairs(d.skins or {}) do skinOverlay[tonumber(k)] = v end
    end
end)

local orig = {}
local function hook(name, fn)
    orig[name] = hookfunction(Inv[name], fn)
end

local function effective(slot)
    local o = slotOverlay[slot]
    if o == nil then return orig.GetEquipped(slot) end
    if o == false then return nil end
    return o
end
local function effectiveSkin(base)
    local o = skinOverlay[base]
    if o == nil then return orig.GetSkin(base) end
    if o == false then return nil end
    return o
end
local refreshLocal
local function fireAll()
    for _, o in ipairs(slotObs) do pcall(o.push) end
    for _, o in ipairs(skinObs) do pcall(o.push) end
    for _, cb in ipairs(loadoutObs) do pcall(cb) end
    if refreshLocal then pcall(refreshLocal) end
end

hook("Owns", function(id)
    if on() and isCosmetic(id) then return true end
    return orig.Owns(id)
end)
hook("IsUnlocked", function(id)
    if on() and isCosmetic(id) then return true end
    return orig.IsUnlocked(id)
end)
hook("OwnedIds", function()
    local list = orig.OwnedIds()
    if not on() then return list end
    local have = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(list) do have[id] = true end
    for _, id in ipairs(allCosmetics) do if not have[id] then list[#list + 1] = id end end
    table.sort(list)
    return list
end)
hook("GetOwnedBySlotType", function(slotType)
    local list = orig.GetOwnedBySlotType(slotType)
    if not on() or not COSMETIC_SLOT[slotType] then return list end
    local have = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(list) do have[id] = true end
    for _, id in ipairs(allCosmetics) do
        if not have[id] and slotTypeOf(id) == slotType then list[#list + 1] = id end
    end
    return list
end)
hook("IsSlotAvailable", function(slot)
    if on() and COSMETIC_SLOT[Inv.GetSlotType(slot)] then return true end
    return orig.IsSlotAvailable(slot)
end)
hook("GetEquipped", function(slot)
    if not on() then return orig.GetEquipped(slot) end
    return effective(slot)
end)
hook("GetLoadout", function()
    local r = orig.GetLoadout()
    if not on() then return r end
    for slot, v in pairs(slotOverlay) do r[slot] = v or nil end
    return r
end)
hook("IsEquipped", function(id)
    if not on() then return orig.IsEquipped(id) end
    for slot in pairs(Inv.GetSlots()) do
        if effective(slot) == id then return true, slot end
    end
    return false, nil
end)
hook("ObserveSlot", function(slot, cb)
    local entry = {push = function() cb(on() and effective(slot) or orig.GetEquipped(slot)) end}
    local disc = orig.ObserveSlot(slot, function() entry.push() end)
    slotObs[#slotObs + 1] = entry
    return function()
        pcall(disc)
        local i = table.find(slotObs, entry)
        if i then table.remove(slotObs, i) end
    end
end)
hook("ObserveLoadout", function(cb)
    local disc = orig.ObserveLoadout(cb)
    loadoutObs[#loadoutObs + 1] = cb
    return function()
        pcall(disc)
        local i = table.find(loadoutObs, cb)
        if i then table.remove(loadoutObs, i) end
    end
end)
hook("GetSkin", function(base)
    if not on() then return orig.GetSkin(base) end
    return effectiveSkin(base)
end)
hook("ObserveSkin", function(base, cb)
    local entry = {push = function() cb(on() and effectiveSkin(base) or orig.GetSkin(base)) end}
    local disc = orig.ObserveSkin(base, function() entry.push() end)
    skinObs[#skinObs + 1] = entry
    return function()
        pcall(disc)
        local i = table.find(skinObs, entry)
        if i then table.remove(skinObs, i) end
    end
end)

local function handleEquip(slot, id)
    if type(slot) ~= "string" or not COSMETIC_SLOT[Inv.GetSlotType(slot)] then return false end
    if id == nil then
        if slotOverlay[slot] ~= nil then slotOverlay[slot] = nil save() fireAll() return true end
        return false
    end
    local fake = isCosmetic(id) and not orig.Owns(id)
    local locked = not orig.IsSlotAvailable(slot)
    if fake or locked then
        slotOverlay[slot] = id
        save() fireAll()
        return true
    end
    if slotOverlay[slot] ~= nil then slotOverlay[slot] = nil save() fireAll() end
    return false
end
local function handleSwap(a, b)
    if slotOverlay[a] == nil and slotOverlay[b] == nil then return false end
    local ea, eb = effective(a), effective(b)
    slotOverlay[a] = eb == nil and false or eb
    slotOverlay[b] = ea == nil and false or ea
    save() fireAll()
    return true
end
local function handleSkin(base, skin)
    if skin == nil then
        if skinOverlay[base] ~= nil then skinOverlay[base] = false save() fireAll() return true end
        return false
    end
    if isCosmetic(skin) and not orig.Owns(skin) then
        skinOverlay[base] = skin
        save() fireAll()
        return true
    end
    if skinOverlay[base] ~= nil then skinOverlay[base] = nil save() fireAll() end
    return false
end

local function setLocalEmote(id)
    local lc = CharacterService:GetLocalCharacter()
    if lc and lc.DataRegistry and origSetTerm then origSetTerm(lc.DataRegistry, "Emote", id) end
end
local function handleEmoteTask(kind, id)
    if kind ~= "Emote" then return false end
    if id == nil or id == 0 then
        if fakeEmote then fakeEmote = nil setLocalEmote(0) return true end
        return false
    end
    if type(id) == "number" and isCosmetic(id) and not orig.Owns(id) then
        fakeEmote = id
        setLocalEmote(id)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local oldNamecall
oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    if on() and getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" then
        local handled = false
        if self == EquipRemote then handled = handleEquip(...)
        elseif self == SwapRemote then handled = handleSwap(...)
        elseif self == SetSkinRemote then handled = handleSkin(...)
        elseif self == TaskRemote then handled = handleEmoteTask(...) end
        if handled then blocked += 1 return end
    end
    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end))

local WORN_SLOTS = {"CosmeticSlot_1", "CosmeticSlot_2", "UnusualSlot", "CharacterSlot"}
local OVERRIDE_TERMS = {"Cosmetics", "Nametag", "Emotes"}
local IS_OVERRIDDEN = {Cosmetics = true, Nametag = true, Emotes = true}
local serverVal = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function hasWornOverlay()
    for _, s in ipairs(WORN_SLOTS) do
        if slotOverlay[s] ~= nil then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local function wornList()
    local list = {}
    for _, s in ipairs(WORN_SLOTS) do
        local id = effective(s)
        if id then list[#list + 1] = id end
    end
    return list
end
local function hasEmoteOverlay()
    for i = 1, 12 do
        if slotOverlay["EmoteSlot_" .. i] ~= nil then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local function emoteList()
    local list = {}
    for i = 1, 12 do
        local id = effective("EmoteSlot_" .. i)
        if id then list[#list + 1] = {i, id} end
    end
    return list
end
local function desired(term, serverValue)
    if not on() then return serverValue end
    if term == "Cosmetics" and hasWornOverlay() then return wornList() end
    if term == "Emotes" and hasEmoteOverlay() then return emoteList() end
    if term == "Nametag" and slotOverlay.NametagSlot ~= nil then return effective("NametagSlot") end
    return serverValue
end
local function sameValue(a, b)
    if type(a) == "table" and type(b) == "table" then
        if #a ~= #b then return false end
        for i = 1, #a do if not sameValue(a[i], b[i]) then return false end end
        return true
    end
    return a == b
end

origSetTerm = hookfunction(CharRegistry.SetTerm, function(self, term, value)
    if term == "Emote" and fakeEmote and value ~= fakeEmote then
        local p = rawget(self, "Parent")
        if type(p) == "table" and p.Local then fakeEmote = nil end
    end
    if IS_OVERRIDDEN[term] then
        local p = rawget(self, "Parent")
        if type(p) == "table" and p.Local then
            local sv = serverVal[self]
            if not sv then sv = {seeded = true} serverVal[self] = sv end
            sv[term] = value
            value = desired(term, value)
        end
    end
    return origSetTerm(self, term, value)
end)

refreshLocal = function()
    for _, c in CharacterService:GetCharacters() do
        local reg = c.Local and c.DataRegistry
        if reg then
            local sv = serverVal[reg]
            if not sv then
                sv = {seeded = true, Cosmetics = reg.Data.Cosmetics, Nametag = reg.Data.Nametag, Emotes = reg.Data.Emotes}
                serverVal[reg] = sv
            end
            for _, term in ipairs(OVERRIDE_TERMS) do
                local want = desired(term, sv[term])
                if not sameValue(want, reg.Data[term]) then
                    origSetTerm(reg, term, want)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local running = true
task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        pcall(refreshLocal)
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)
pcall(refreshLocal)

getgenv().UnlockAllStop = function()
    getgenv().unlock_all_enabled = false
    table.clear(slotOverlay) table.clear(skinOverlay)
    pcall(fireAll)
    if fakeEmote then fakeEmote = nil pcall(setLocalEmote, 0) end
    running = false
    getgenv().UnlockAllStop = nil
end
getgenv().UnlockAllDebug = function() return {blocked = blocked, slots = slotOverlay, skins = skinOverlay, cosmetics = #allCosmetics} end

local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local macroActive = false
local selectedEvent = "None"

-- Default Timing Configurations
local timing = {
    qHold = 0.02,
    qRelease = 0.03,
    eHold = 0.02,
    eRelease = 0.00
}

-- Async Input Thread Execution
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if macroActive and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            -- Q Sequence
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Q, false, game)
            task.wait(timing.qHold)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Q, false, game)
            task.wait(timing.qRelease)
            
            -- E Sequence
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
            task.wait(timing.eHold)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
            task.wait(timing.eRelease)
        else
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end
end)

-- GUI Elements Construction
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "EventRunnerMacro"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local success, err = pcall(function()
    ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
end)

    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

Frame.BorderSizePixel = 2
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Custom Dragging Script
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    Frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = Frame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)

StatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
StatusLabel.TextSize = 14
StatusLabel.Parent = Frame

-- Helper to rapidly spin up template layout buttons
local function createPresetButton(name, yPos, qH, qR, eH, eR, isGold)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
    Btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, yPos)
    Btn.Text = name
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    Btn.TextSize = 14
    Btn.Parent = Frame
    
    -- Dynamic styling based on whether it is the gold button
    if isGold then
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(212, 175, 55) -- Gold color
        Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20) -- Dark text for contrast
    else
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    
    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        timing.qHold = qH
        timing.qRelease = qR
        timing.eHold = eH
        timing.eRelease = eR
        macroActive = true
        selectedEvent = name
        StatusLabel.Text = "Status: RUNNING ("..name..")"
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    end)
end

-- Preset configurations (Y-spaced sequentially by 45px)
createPresetButton("60m Dash",   65,  0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.00, false)
createPresetButton("100m Dash",  110, 0.02, 0.03, 0.02, 0.00, false)
createPresetButton("200m Dash",  155, 0.03, 0.02, 0.04, 0.00, false)
createPresetButton("300m Dash",  200, 0.03, 0.02, 0.04, 0.00, false)
createPresetButton("400m Dash",  245, 0.05, 0.04, 0.05, 0.00, false)
createPresetButton("Superspeed", 290, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00, true) -- Updated to 0.00 across all fields

-- Global Keybind Handling
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if not processed then
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
            macroActive = not macroActive
            if macroActive then
                StatusLabel.Text = "Status: RUNNING ("..selectedEvent..")"
                StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            else
                StatusLabel.Text = "Status: PAUSED ("..selectedEvent..")"
                StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
            end
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
            Frame.Visible = not Frame.Visible
        end
    end
end)

    local char = player.Character

    local humanoid = char.Humanoid

local losParams = RaycastParams.new()
losParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
losParams.IgnoreWater = true

local function HasLineOfSight(targetChar)
    local head = targetChar.Head
    if not head then return false end
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local localChar = player.Character
    if not cam or not localChar then return false end
    losParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {localChar, cam, targetChar}
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local dir = head.Position - origin
    local ray = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, losParams)
    return ray == nil or ray.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetChar)
end

-- AIMBOT (OPTIMIZED)
---------------------------
local AIM_USE_LOS = true
local AIM_DEBUG = false
local AIM_THROTTLE = 3
local frameCounter = 0

-- OPTIMIZE: reusable table to reduce GC pressure
local candidateBuffer = {}

RunService:BindToRenderStep("SerenityAimbot", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
    if not AimbotEnabled or not HoldingRMB then
        if Attacking then Attacking = nil IsLocked = false end
        return
    end

    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then return end

    if isCharacterDisabled() then
        Attacking = nil
        IsLocked = false
        return
    end

    frameCounter = frameCounter + 1
    local doSearch = (frameCounter % AIM_THROTTLE) == 0

    if not charsFolder or not charsFolder.Parent then
        charsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
    end

    local localChar = player.Character
    local localHrp = localChar and localChar.HumanoidRootPart
    local mousePos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()

    -- Validate current lock
    if Attacking then
        local c = Attacking.char
        if not c or not c.Parent then
            Attacking = nil
            IsLocked = false
        else
            local head = c:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local dist = (hrp and localHrp) and (hrp.Position - localHrp.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
            local dead = hum and hum.Health <= 0
            local disabled = Attacking.plr and isCharDisabledByName(Attacking.plr.Name)

            if not head or dead or disabled or dist > AimbotRange then
                Attacking = nil
                IsLocked = false
            else
                LastTargetPosition = head.Position
                LastTargetVelocity = head.Velocity
            end
        end
    end

    -- Search (throttled)
    if not Attacking and doSearch then
        local bestTarget = nil
        local bufIndex = 0
        
        local function consider(char, plr)
            if not char or not char.Parent then return end
            if plr == player then return end
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not head then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return end
            if plr then
                if isCharDisabledByName(plr.Name) then return end
                if TargetBlueOnly and not blueNames[plr.Name] then return end
            end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local dist = (hrp and localHrp) and (hrp.Position - localHrp.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
            if dist > AimbotRange then return end

            local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            if not onScreen then return end
            local dx = screenPos.X - mousePos.X
            local dy = screenPos.Y - mousePos.Y
            local d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
            local fov2 = MouseFOVRadius * MouseFOVRadius
            if d2 > fov2 then return end

            bufIndex = bufIndex + 1
            candidateBuffer[bufIndex] = {char = char, plr = plr, d2 = d2}
        end

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            consider(plr.Character, plr)
        end

        if charsFolder then
            for _, obj in ipairs(charsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                local rig
                if obj:IsA("Model") then
                    rig = obj
                elseif obj:IsA("Folder") then
                    rig = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
                end
                if rig then
                    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(rig) or Players:FindFirstChild(obj.Name)
                    consider(rig, plr)
                end
            end
        end

        -- clear trailing buffer entries
        for i = bufIndex + 1, #candidateBuffer do
            candidateBuffer[i] = nil
        end

        if bufIndex > 0 then
            -- sort by 2D squared distance
            table.sort(candidateBuffer, function(a, b) return a.d2 < b.d2 end)

            -- OPTIMIZE: only LOS-check top 4 candidates (usually enough)
            local maxCheck = math.min(bufIndex, 4)
            for i = 1, maxCheck do
                local cand = candidateBuffer[i]
                if (not AIM_USE_LOS) or HasLineOfSight(cand.char) then
                    bestTarget = cand
                    break
                end
            end

            -- cleanup
            for i = 1, bufIndex do candidateBuffer[i] = nil end
        end

        if bestTarget then
            Attacking = {char = bestTarget.char, plr = bestTarget.plr}
            IsLocked = true
            local head = bestTarget.char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head then
                LastTargetPosition = head.Position
                LastTargetVelocity = head.Velocity
            end
        end
    end

    -- Aim
    if Attacking and IsLocked then
        local tChar = Attacking.char
        if not tChar or not tChar.Parent then return end
        local head = tChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end

        LastTargetPosition = head.Position
        LastTargetVelocity = head.Velocity

        local pred = head.Position + (head.Velocity * PredictionFactor)
        local smoothFactor = 1 / (AimSmoothness * 60)
        if smoothFactor < 0.01 then smoothFactor = 0.01
        elseif smoothFactor > 1 then smoothFactor = 1 end

        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, pred), smoothFactor)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    local cachedLPGui = nil
    local cachedFramesFolder = nil
    local cachedSelections = nil
    local cachedScales = nil

    while true do
        if not (ScriptEnabled and lpActive) then
            if cachedScales then
                for i = 1, #cachedScales do
                    local s = cachedScales[i]
                    if s and s.Parent and s.Scale ~= 1 then s.Scale = 1 end
                end
            end
            cachedLPGui = nil
            cachedFramesFolder = nil
            cachedSelections = nil
            cachedScales = nil
            task.wait(1)
        else
            local lpgui = cachedLPGui
            if not lpgui or not lpgui.Parent then
                lpgui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("LockpickGUI")
                cachedLPGui = lpgui
                cachedFramesFolder = nil
                cachedSelections = nil
                cachedScales = nil
            end

            if lpgui and lpgui.Enabled then
                if not cachedFramesFolder or not cachedFramesFolder.Parent then
                    local mf = lpgui:FindFirstChild("MF")
                    local lpFrame = mf and mf:FindFirstChild("LP_Frame")
                    cachedFramesFolder = lpFrame and lpFrame:FindFirstChild("Frames")
                    if cachedFramesFolder then
                        cachedSelections = {
                            cachedFramesFolder.B1.Bar.Selection,
                            cachedFramesFolder.B2.Bar.Selection,
                            cachedFramesFolder.B3.Bar.Selection,
                        }
                        cachedScales = {}
                        for i = 1, 3 do
                            local parent = cachedSelections[i].Parent
                            local s = parent:FindFirstChild("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale", parent)
                            cachedScales[i] = s
                        end
                    end
                end

                if cachedSelections then
                    for i = 1, 3 do
                        local s = cachedScales[i]
                        if s then s.Scale = 10 end
                        local v = cachedSelections[i]
                        local y = v.AbsolutePosition.Y
                        if y >= 450 and y <= 550 then
                            if typeof(mouse1click) == "function" then
                                mouse1click()
                                task.wait(0.1)
                                mouse1release()
                            else
                                warn("SERENITY: executor lacks mouse1click")
                                task.wait(1)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait()
            else
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end
    end
end)

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 20)
status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 220)
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = "Ready"
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.TextSize = 13
status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
status.Parent = frame

local function getRoot()
	local character = player.Character
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function buildText()
	local root = getRoot()
	if not root then
		status.Text = "No character found"
		return
	end

	local text = string.upper(textInput.Text)
	if #text == 0 then
		status.Text = "Enter some text first"
		return
	end

	local size = math.clamp(tonumber(sizeInput.Text) or 1, 0.2, 10)
	local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local origin = root.Position + look * 12 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	local base = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + look)

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "TextBlocks_" .. text
	local blockCount = 0
	local totalCols = #text * 6 - 1
	local startX = -((totalCols - 1) / 2) * size

	for i = 1, #text do
		local ch = string.sub(text, i, i)
		local glyph = glyphs[ch]
		if glyph then
			local colOffset = (i - 1) * 6
			local hue = (i - 1) / math.max(#text, 1)
			local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.6, 1)
			for row = 1, 7 do
				local line = glyph[row]
				for col = 1, 5 do
					if string.sub(line, col, col) == "#" then
						local x = startX + (colOffset + col - 1) * size
						local y = (7 - row) * size
						local part = Instance.new("Part")
						part.Size = Vector3.new(size, size, size)
						part.Anchored = true
						part.CanCollide = true
						part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
						part.Color = color
						part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
						part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
						part.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(x, y, 0)
						part.Parent = model
						blockCount += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if blockCount == 0 then
		model:Destroy()
		status.Text = "No supported characters (A-Z, 0-9)"
		return
	end

	model.Parent = workspace
	table.insert(builtModels, model)
	status.Text = "Built " .. blockCount .. " blocks"
end

buildBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(buildText)

undoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local last = table.remove(builtModels)
	if last then
		last:Destroy()
		status.Text = "Undid last build"
	else
		status.Text = "Nothing to undo"
	end
end)

clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, model in ipairs(builtModels) do
		model:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(builtModels)
	status.Text = "Cleared all text"
end)

	"Root", "Waist", "Neck",
	"RightShoulder", "RightElbow", "RightWrist",
	"LeftShoulder", "LeftElbow", "LeftWrist",
	"RightHip", "RightKnee", "RightAnkle",
	"LeftHip", "LeftKnee", "LeftAnkle"
}

local function GetFXFolder(): Folder
	if EffectsFolder and EffectsFolder.Parent == Workspace then return EffectsFolder end
	local f = Workspace:FindFirstChild("SpiderFX_" .. LocalPlayer.UserId)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = "SpiderFX_" .. LocalPlayer.UserId
		f.Parent = Workspace
	end
	EffectsFolder = f
	return f
end

local function DestroyLater(inst: Instance?, t: number)
	if not inst then return end
	if t <= 0 then
		pcall(inst.Destroy, inst)
	else
		task.delay(t, function()
			if inst and inst.Parent then pcall(inst.Destroy, inst) end
		end)
	end
end

local function RayParams(): RaycastParams
	local p = RaycastParams.new()
	p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	p.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Char, EffectsFolder }
	p.IgnoreWater = true
	return p
end

local function CheckCooldown(name: string): boolean
	local t = os.clock()
	if (State.Cooldowns[name] or 0) > t then return false end
	State.Cooldowns[name] = t + (CFG.Cooldowns[name] or 1)
	return true
end

local function GetMass(): number
	return (Root and Root.AssemblyMass > 0) and Root.AssemblyMass or 16
end

local function MoveDir(): Vector3
	if Hum and Hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 then return Hum.MoveDirection.Unit end
	local l = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local f = v3(l.X, 0, l.Z)
	return f.Magnitude > 0.01 and f.Unit or v3(0, 0, -1)
end

local function NextWrist(): (Attachment?, boolean)
	State.Hand = (State.Hand == "Right") and "Left" or "Right"
	local isRight = (State.Hand == "Right")
	return (isRight and Phys.RightWrist or Phys.LeftWrist) or Phys.RootAtt, isRight
end

local function PlaySFX(key: string, vol: number?, pitch: number?, parent: Instance?)
	local id = CFG.Sounds[key]
	if not id then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if SoundTimes[key] and now - SoundTimes[key] < 0.04 then return end
	SoundTimes[key] = now
	pcall(function()
		local s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.SoundId = id
		s.Volume = vol or 0.65
		s.PlaybackSpeed = clamp((pitch or 1) + math.random(-6, 6) * 0.01, 0.5, 2.2)
		s.RollOffMaxDistance = 150
		s.Parent = parent or Root or Workspace
		s:Play()
		DestroyLater(s, 3.5)
	end)
end

local function StyleWebBeam(b: Beam, w0: number, w1: number, curve: number?)
	b.Color = ColorSequence.new(CFG.Colors.White)
	b.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.12),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.05)
	})
	b.Width0 = w0
	b.Width1 = w1
	b.CurveSize0 = curve or 0
	b.CurveSize1 = -(curve or 0)
	b.FaceCamera = true
	b.LightEmission = 0.35
	b.Segments = 20
end

local function EmitWebFlash(att: Attachment?)
	if not att then return end
	local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	p.Color = ColorSequence.new(CFG.Colors.White)
	p.LightEmission = 0.6
	p.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.1, 0.2)
	p.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18)
	p.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(30, 30)
	p.Rate = 0
	p.Parent = att
	p:Emit(7)
	DestroyLater(p, 0.3)
end

local function SpawnWebSplat(pos: Vector3, norm: Vector3, buildWeb: boolean?)
	local node = Instance.new("Part")
	node.Anchored = true
	node.CanCollide = false
	node.CanQuery = false
	node.CanTouch = false
	node.Transparency = 1
	node.Size = v3(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	node.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + norm)
	node.Parent = GetFXFolder()

	local center = Instance.new("Attachment", node)
	local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", center)
	p.Color = ColorSequence.new(CFG.Colors.White)
	p.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.1, 1)
	p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.18, 0.38)
	p.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 22)
	p.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(75, 75)
	p.Drag = 5
	p.Rate = 0
	p:Emit(12)

	if buildWeb then
		local ring = {}
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local a = (i / 8) * pi * 2
			local att = Instance.new("Attachment", node)
			att.Position = v3(cos(a) * 2.2, sin(a) * 2.2, 0.04)
			ring[i] = att
			local spoke = Instance.new("Beam", node)
			StyleWebBeam(spoke, 0.08, 0.05)
			spoke.Attachment0 = center
			spoke.Attachment1 = att
		end
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local webRing = Instance.new("Beam", node)
			StyleWebBeam(webRing, 0.07, 0.07)
			webRing.Attachment0 = ring[i]
			webRing.Attachment1 = ring[(i % 8) + 1]
		end
		DestroyLater(node, 4.0)
	else
		DestroyLater(node, 0.5)
	end
end

local function Shockwave(pos: Vector3, radius: number, col: Color3?)
	local ring = Instance.new("Part")
	ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	ring.Anchored = true
	ring.CanCollide = false
	ring.CanQuery = false
	ring.CanTouch = false
	ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ring.Color = col or CFG.Colors.White
	ring.Transparency = 0.25
	ring.Size = v3(0.3, 1.5, 1.5)
	ring.CFrame = cf(pos) * ang(0, 0, rad(90))
	ring.Parent = GetFXFolder()
	TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.38, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = v3(0.08, radius, radius), Transparency = 1
	}):Play()
	DestroyLater(ring, 0.42)
end

local function ShootAnimatedWebLine(fromAtt: Attachment?, targetPos: Vector3, duration: number)
	if not fromAtt then return end
	local endPart = Instance.new("Part")
	endPart.Anchored = true
	endPart.CanCollide = false
	endPart.CanQuery = false
	endPart.CanTouch = false
	endPart.Transparency = 1
	endPart.Size = v3(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	endPart.Position = fromAtt.WorldPosition
	endPart.Parent = GetFXFolder()

	local endAtt = Instance.new("Attachment", endPart)
	local b0 = Instance.new("Beam", endPart)
	StyleWebBeam(b0, 0.12, 0.16, 1.2)
	b0.Attachment0 = fromAtt
	b0.Attachment1 = endAtt

	TweenService:Create(endPart, TweenInfo.new(0.07, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Position = targetPos }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(b0, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), { CurveSize0 = 0, CurveSize1 = 0 }):Play()
	DestroyLater(endPart, duration)
end

local function SetPose(pose: { [string]: CFrame }, weight: number, speed: number?)
	Proc.Pose = pose
	Proc.TargetWeight = clamp(weight, 0, 1)
	Proc.Speed = speed or 14
end

local function ActionPose(pose: { [string]: CFrame }, duration: number, speed: number?)
	Proc.ActionPose = pose
	Proc.ActionUntil = os.clock() + duration
	Proc.ActionSpeed = speed or 22
end

local function StopAnimations()
	if Tracks.Swing and Tracks.Swing.IsPlaying then Tracks.Swing:Stop(0.2) end
	if Tracks.Crawl and Tracks.Crawl.IsPlaying then Tracks.Crawl:Stop(0.2) end
end

local function ResetPhysics()
	if Phys.Rope then Phys.Rope.Enabled = false end
	if Phys.Force then Phys.Force.Enabled = false; Phys.Force.Force = Vector3.zero end
	if Phys.Vel then Phys.Vel.Enabled = false; Phys.Vel.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero end
	if Phys.Align then Phys.Align.Enabled = false end
	if Phys.Beam0 then Phys.Beam0.Enabled = false end
	if Phys.Beam1 then Phys.Beam1.Enabled = false end
	if Phys.WingL then Phys.WingL.Enabled = false end
	if Phys.WingR then Phys.WingR.Enabled = false end
	if UI.Shield then DestroyLater(UI.Shield, 0); UI.Shield = nil end
end

local function CancelAll()
	State.Mode = "Idle"
	State.WebAttached = false
	ResetPhysics()
	StopAnimations()
	SetPose({}, 0, 14)
	if Hum then
		Hum.PlatformStand = false
		Hum.AutoRotate = true
		Hum.WalkSpeed = 30
		if Hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics then
			Hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
		end
	end
end

local function FindSwingPoint(): (Vector3, boolean)
	if not Root then return Vector3.zero, false end
	local origin = Root.Position + v3(0, 2, 0)
	local camCF = Camera.CFrame
	local look = camCF.LookVector
	local flatLook = v3(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	flatLook = flatLook.Magnitude > 0.05 and flatLook.Unit or Root.CFrame.LookVector

	local params = RayParams()
	local rays = {
		(look + v3(0, 0.6, 0)).Unit,
		(flatLook + v3(0, 0.85, 0)).Unit,
		(flatLook + camCF.RightVector * 0.35 + v3(0, 0.8, 0)).Unit,
		(flatLook - camCF.RightVector * 0.35 + v3(0, 0.8, 0)).Unit,
		(flatLook + camCF.RightVector * 0.6 + v3(0, 0.9, 0)).Unit,
		(flatLook - camCF.RightVector * 0.6 + v3(0, 0.9, 0)).Unit,
		(flatLook + v3(0, 1.35, 0)).Unit,
	}

	local bestPos: Vector3? = nil
	local bestScore = -1e9
	for _, dir in ipairs(rays) do
		local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * 265, params)
		if hit and hit.Position.Y > Root.Position.Y + 14 then
			local delta = hit.Position - Root.Position
			local dist = delta.Magnitude
			if dist >= 24 and dist <= 265 then
				local score = delta.Unit:Dot(flatLook) * 70 + (hit.Position.Y - Root.Position.Y) * 0.45 - abs(dist - 95) * 0.25
				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore = score
					bestPos = hit.Position
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if bestPos then return bestPos, true end

	local vel = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local horizSpeed = v3(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
	local swingDir = (flatLook * 0.75 + MoveDir() * 0.25).Unit
	return Root.Position + swingDir * (64 + clamp(horizSpeed * 0.38, 0, 38)) + v3(0, 74, 0), false
end

local function StartSwing()
	if not Root or not Hum or Hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	if State.Mode ~= "Idle" then CancelAll() end

	local anchor, isReal = FindSwingPoint()
	if not Phys.AnchorPart or not Phys.Rope or not Phys.Force or not Phys.Align or not Phys.Beam0 or not Phys.Beam1 then return end

	State.Mode = "Swinging"
	State.SwingAnchor = anchor
	State.SwingStart = os.clock()
	State.WebAttached = false

	local wrist, isRight = NextWrist()
	local startPos = wrist and wrist.WorldPosition or Root.Position
	Phys.AnchorPart.Position = startPos

	Phys.Beam0.Attachment0 = wrist
	Phys.Beam0.Attachment1 = Phys.AnchorAtt
	Phys.Beam1.Attachment0 = wrist
	Phys.Beam1.Attachment1 = Phys.AnchorAtt
	StyleWebBeam(Phys.Beam0, 0.14, 0.2, 2.6)
	StyleWebBeam(Phys.Beam1, 0.08, 0.12, -1.8)
	Phys.Beam0.Enabled = true
	Phys.Beam1.Enabled = true

	EmitWebFlash(wrist)
	PlaySFX(isRight and "WEB_SHOOT" or "WEB_SHOOT_ALT", 0.75, 1.02)

	-- Realistic web shoot travel time (0.065s) before pendulum tension engages
	TweenService:Create(Phys.AnchorPart, TweenInfo.new(0.065, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Position = anchor }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(Phys.Beam0, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { CurveSize0 = 0, CurveSize1 = 0 }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(Phys.Beam1, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { CurveSize0 = 0, CurveSize1 = 0 }):Play()

	Hum.AutoRotate = false
	StopAnimations()
	if Tracks.Swing then Tracks.Swing:Play(0.2, 1, 1.0) end

	task.delay(0.065, function()
		if State.Mode ~= "Swinging" or not Root then return end
		State.WebAttached = true
		Phys.AnchorPart.Position = anchor
		if isReal then SpawnWebSplat(anchor, Vector3.yAxis, false) end

		local dist = (anchor - Root.Position).Magnitude
		local floorCheck = Workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, v3(0, -16, 0), RayParams())
		if floorCheck and Hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += v3(0, 32, 0)
			dist *= 0.85
		end

		Phys.Rope.Length = clamp(dist * 0.95, 16, 250)
		Phys.Rope.Enabled = true
		Phys.Force.Force = Vector3.zero
		Phys.Force.Enabled = true
		Phys.Align.CFrame = Root.CFrame
		Phys.Align.Enabled = true
		PlaySFX("WHOOSH", 0.55, 1.0)
	end)
end

local function ReleaseSwing(jumpBoost: boolean?)
	if State.Mode ~= "Swinging" then return end
	local holdTime = os.clock() - State.SwingStart
	CancelAll()

	if Root and jumpBoost and holdTime > 0.08 then
		local vel = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local horiz = v3(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
		local dir = horiz.Magnitude > 6 and horiz.Unit or MoveDir()
		local speedBonus = clamp(horiz.Magnitude * 0.25, 18, 42)
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = v3(vel.X * 0.92, max(vel.Y * 0.72, 0), vel.Z * 0.92) + dir * speedBonus + v3(0, 40, 0)
		CamState.Shake = 0.35
		PlaySFX("SWOOSH", 0.7, 1.08)

		ActionPose({
			Root = ang(rad(-32), 0, 0),
			Waist = ang(rad(24), 0, 0),
			RightShoulder = ang(rad(145), rad(-15), rad(25)),
			LeftShoulder = ang(rad(145), rad(15), rad(-25)),
			RightHip = ang(rad(42), 0, 0),
			RightKnee = ang(rad(-75), 0, 0),
			LeftHip = ang(rad(-18), 0, 0),
			LeftKnee = ang(rad(-35), 0, 0),
		}, 0.45, 18)
	end
end

local function StepSwing(dt: number)
	if not State.WebAttached then return end
	if not Root or not Hum or not Phys.Rope or not Phys.Force or not Phys.Align then
		ReleaseSwing(false)
		return
	end

	local pos = Root.Position
	local toAnchor = State.SwingAnchor - pos
	local dist = toAnchor.Magnitude
	if dist < 5 then
		ReleaseSwing(true)
		return
	end

	local ropeDir = toAnchor.Unit
	local vel = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local speed = vel.Magnitude
	local mass = GetMass()

	-- Realistic Pendulum Physics: Project steering input onto the plane perpendicular to the rope
	local camLook = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local flatCam = v3(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z)
	flatCam = flatCam.Magnitude > 0.01 and flatCam.Unit or Root.CFrame.LookVector
	local steer = Hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 and (Hum.MoveDirection * 0.75 + flatCam * 0.25).Unit or flatCam

	local tangent = steer - ropeDir * steer:Dot(ropeDir)
	tangent = tangent.Magnitude > 0.01 and tangent.Unit or steer

	-- Gravity conversion: Diving accelerates downward, nadir converts speed into upward arc
	local diving = camLook.Y < -0.32
	local nadirFactor = clamp(-ropeDir.Y, 0, 1)
	local downSwingBoost = (vel.Y < -5) and 1.35 or 1.0
	local thrust = 3850 * (mass / 16) * (diving and 1.55 or downSwingBoost)

	-- Ground clearance protection (reels rope smoothly if close to street)
	local groundHit = Workspace:Raycast(pos, v3(0, -15, 0), RayParams())
	local groundLift = 0
	if groundHit and groundHit.Distance < 9 then
		groundLift = (9 - groundHit.Distance) * 48 * mass
		Phys.Rope.Length = max(14, Phys.Rope.Length - dt * 26)
	elseif pos.Y < State.SwingAnchor.Y - 14 and vel.Y < 0 then
		Phys.Rope.Length = max(18, Phys.Rope.Length - dt * 5.5)
	end

	-- Aerodynamic drag + centripetal arc lift
	local airDrag = -vel * (speed * 0.008 * (mass / 16))
	local arcLift = (vel.Y > -6 and pos.Y < State.SwingAnchor.Y - 6) and (mass * 34 * nadirFactor) or 0

	Phys.Force.Force = (tangent * thrust) + airDrag + v3(0, groundLift + arcLift + (diving and -mass * 42 or 0), 0)

	-- Realistic Pendulum Body Alignment: Character's UpVector aligns with the taut web rope!
	local forwardVel = speed > 7 and vel.Unit or tangent
	local rightVec = forwardVel:Cross(ropeDir)
	rightVec = rightVec.Magnitude > 0.01 and rightVec.Unit or Camera.CFrame.RightVector
	local bodyUp = rightVec:Cross(forwardVel).Unit
	if bodyUp.Y < 0 then bodyUp = -bodyUp end

	local worldUpBlend = bodyUp:Lerp(Vector3.yAxis, 0.22).Unit
	local finalRight = forwardVel:Cross(worldUpBlend).Unit
	Phys.Align.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(pos, finalRight, worldUpBlend)

	-- Dynamic G-Force Procedural Pose blended with user's Swing Animation
	local side = (State.Hand == "Right") and 1 or -1
	local legTuck = clamp(speed / 95, 0, 1) * 35
	SetPose({
		Waist = ang(rad(14 + legTuck * 0.2), rad(-12 * side), rad(-8 * side)),
		Neck = ang(rad(18), rad(10 * side), 0),
		RightShoulder = (State.Hand == "Right") and ang(rad(148), 0, rad(10)) or ang(rad(-32), 0, rad(22)),
		LeftShoulder = (State.Hand == "Left") and ang(rad(148), 0, rad(-10)) or ang(rad(-32), 0, rad(-22)),
		RightHip = ang(rad(20 + legTuck), 0, rad(6)),
		RightKnee = ang(rad(-35 - legTuck), 0, 0),
		LeftHip = ang(rad(-10 + legTuck * 0.5), 0, rad(-6)),
		LeftKnee = ang(rad(-25 - legTuck * 0.5), 0, 0),
	}, 0.6, 12)

	-- Release automatically at the top of a high arc
	if pos.Y > State.SwingAnchor.Y + 12 and (os.clock() - State.SwingStart) > 0.55 then
		ReleaseSwing(true)
	end
end

local function ProbeCrawlSurface(): RaycastResult?
	if not Root then return nil end
	local p = RayParams()
	local c = Root.CFrame
	local dirs = {
		c.LookVector * 5.0,
		(c.LookVector + c.UpVector * 0.5).Unit * 5.2,
		(c.LookVector - c.UpVector * 0.7).Unit * 5.2,
		-c.UpVector * 4.8,
		v3(Camera.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, Camera.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit * 4.8,
	}
	for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
		local hit = Workspace:Raycast(c.Position, d, p)
		if hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance.CanCollide and hit.Normal.Y < 0.76 then
			return hit
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function StartCrawl(initialHit: RaycastResult?)
	if not Root or not Hum or Hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	if os.clock() - State.LastCrawlExit < 0.35 then return end
	local hit = initialHit or ProbeCrawlSurface()
	if not hit then return end

	CancelAll()
	State.Mode = "Crawling"
	State.CrawlNormal = hit.Normal

	Hum.PlatformStand = true
	Hum.AutoRotate = false
	if Phys.Vel and Phys.Align then
		Phys.Vel.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
		Phys.Vel.Enabled = true
		Phys.Align.CFrame = Root.CFrame
		Phys.Align.Enabled = true
	end

	StopAnimations()
	if Tracks.Crawl then Tracks.Crawl:Play(0.15, 1, 0) end
	PlaySFX("IMPACT", 0.35, 1.4)
end

local function StopCrawl(wallJump: boolean?)
	if State.Mode ~= "Crawling" then return end
	local norm = State.CrawlNormal
	State.LastCrawlExit = os.clock()
	CancelAll()

	if Root and wallJump then
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (norm * 0.72 + v3(0, 0.78, 0)).Unit * 86
		PlaySFX("WHOOSH", 0.68, 1.15)
		SpawnWebSplat(Root.Position - norm * 1.8, norm, false)
		ActionPose({
			Root = ang(rad(38), 0, 0),
			Waist = ang(rad(-24), 0, 0),
			RightShoulder = ang(rad(125), 0, rad(35)),
			LeftShoulder = ang(rad(125), 0, rad(-35)),
			RightHip = ang(rad(48), 0, 0),
			RightKnee = ang(rad(-85), 0, 0),
			LeftHip = ang(rad(48), 0, 0),
			LeftKnee = ang(rad(-85), 0, 0),
		}, 0.42, 18)
	end
end

local function StepCrawl(dt: number)
	if not Root or not Hum or not Phys.Vel or not Phys.Align then
		StopCrawl(false)
		return
	end

	local c = Root.CFrame
	local norm = State.CrawlNormal
	local input = Hum.MoveDirection
	local moveVec = Vector3.zero

	if input.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		local cam = Camera.CFrame
		local camFwd = cam.LookVector - norm * cam.LookVector:Dot(norm)
		if camFwd.Magnitude < 0.05 then camFwd = Vector3.yAxis - norm * Vector3.yAxis:Dot(norm) end
		camFwd = camFwd.Unit
		local camRight = (cam.RightVector - norm * cam.RightVector:Dot(norm))
		camRight = camRight.Magnitude > 0.05 and camRight.Unit or c.RightVector

		local flatLook = v3(cam.LookVector.X, 0, cam.LookVector.Z)
		local flatRight = v3(cam.RightVector.X, 0, cam.RightVector.Z)
		local fwdIn = flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 and input:Dot(flatLook.Unit) or 0
		local rightIn = flatRight.Magnitude > 0.01 and input:Dot(flatRight.Unit) or 0

		local combined = camFwd * fwdIn + camRight * rightIn
		if combined.Magnitude > 0.05 then moveVec = combined.Unit end
	end

	local p = RayParams()
	local hit: RaycastResult? = nil
	if moveVec.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		-- Inside corner check
		hit = Workspace:Raycast(c.Position, moveVec * 3.5, p)
	end
	if not hit then
		-- Direct surface check
		hit = Workspace:Raycast(c.Position + moveVec * 1.1, -norm * 5.0, p)
	end
	if not hit and moveVec.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		-- Outside corner wrap check
		hit = Workspace:Raycast(c.Position + moveVec * 2.6 - norm * 2.4, -moveVec * 4.2, p)
	end

	if not hit or not hit.Instance or (hit.Normal.Y > 0.82 and moveVec.Y < -0.1) then
		StopCrawl(false)
		return
	end

	State.CrawlNormal = norm:Lerp(hit.Normal, clamp(dt * 15, 0, 1)).Unit
	norm = State.CrawlNormal

	-- Realistic close-to-wall adhesion (1.55 studs so hands & feet contact the wall)
	local targetPos = hit.Position + norm * 1.55
	local tangentVel = (moveVec - norm * moveVec:Dot(norm))
	tangentVel = tangentVel.Magnitude > 0.01 and tangentVel.Unit * 24 or Vector3.zero
	Phys.Vel.VectorVelocity = tangentVel + (targetPos - c.Position) * 16

	local faceDir = tangentVel.Magnitude > 0.5 and tangentVel.Unit or (c.LookVector - norm * c.LookVector:Dot(norm))
	if faceDir.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		faceDir = norm:Cross(Vector3.xAxis)
		if faceDir.Magnitude < 0.05 then faceDir = norm:Cross(Vector3.zAxis) end
	end
	faceDir = faceDir.Unit
	local right = faceDir:Cross(norm).Unit
	local upOnWall = norm:Cross(right).Unit

	Phys.Align.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(c.Position, right, norm, -upOnWall) * ang(rad(-84), 0, 0)

	local moving = tangentVel.Magnitude > 0.5
	if Tracks.Crawl then Tracks.Crawl:AdjustSpeed(moving and 1.35 or 0) end

	local cycle = os.clock() * 12
	local limb = moving and sin(cycle) * 30 or 0
	SetPose({
		Waist = ang(rad(-16), rad(limb * 0.25), 0),
		Neck = ang(rad(45), 0, 0),
		RightShoulder = ang(rad(70 + limb), rad(28), rad(52)),
		RightElbow = ang(rad(58), 0, 0),
		LeftShoulder = ang(rad(70 - limb), rad(-28), rad(-52)),
		LeftElbow = ang(rad(58), 0, 0),
		RightHip = ang(rad(60 - limb), rad(-24), rad(38)),
		RightKnee = ang(rad(-78), 0, 0),
		LeftHip = ang(rad(60 + limb), rad(24), rad(-38)),
		LeftKnee = ang(rad(-78), 0, 0),
	}, 0.78, 15)
end

local function WebZip()
	if not Root or not Hum or Hum.Health <= 0 or not CheckCooldown("WebZip") then return end
	if State.Mode ~= "Idle" then CancelAll() end

	State.Mode = "WebZipping"
	State.AirZips += 1

	local camLook = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local zipDir = (camLook + v3(0, 0.15, 0)).Unit
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, zipDir * 140, RayParams())
	local target = hit and hit.Position or (Root.Position + zipDir * 95)

	local wrist, isRight = NextWrist()
	EmitWebFlash(wrist)
	ShootAnimatedWebLine(wrist, target, 0.35)
	if hit then SpawnWebSplat(target, hit.Normal, false) end
	PlaySFX("WEB_SHOOT_ALT", 0.75, 1.1)

	-- Stage 1: Shoot & Reach Forward
	SetPose({
		Root = ang(rad(-28), rad(isRight and -16 or 16), 0),
		Waist = ang(rad(-20), rad(isRight and 20 or -20), 0),
		Neck = ang(rad(26), rad(isRight and -14 or 14), 0),
		RightShoulder = isRight and ang(rad(118), rad(8), rad(6)) or ang(rad(-40), 0, rad(22)),
		LeftShoulder = (not isRight) and ang(rad(118), rad(-8), rad(-6)) or ang(rad(-40), 0, rad(-22)),
		RightHip = ang(rad(-25), 0, 0),
		RightKnee = ang(rad(-45), 0, 0),
		LeftHip = ang(rad(25), 0, 0),
		LeftKnee = ang(rad(-70), 0, 0),
	}, 1.0, 26)

	-- Stage 2: Tension Yank after web connects (0.06s)
	task.delay(0.06, function()
		if State.Mode ~= "WebZipping" or not Root then return end
		PlaySFX("WHOOSH", 0.8, 1.2)
		CamState.Shake = 0.3
		if Phys.Vel and Phys.Align then
			Hum.AutoRotate = false
			Phys.Align.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Root.Position, Root.Position + zipDir)
			Phys.Align.Enabled = true
			Phys.Vel.VectorVelocity = zipDir * 132
			Phys.Vel.Enabled = true
		end
	end)

	-- Stage 3: Aerodynamic Tuck & Pull-Through
	task.delay(0.18, function()
		if State.Mode ~= "WebZipping" then return end
		SetPose({
			Root = ang(rad(20), 0, 0),
			Waist = ang(rad(-26), 0, 0),
			RightShoulder = ang(rad(-38), 0, rad(28)),
			RightElbow = ang(rad(75), 0, 0),
			LeftShoulder = ang(rad(-38), 0, rad(-28)),
			LeftElbow = ang(rad(75), 0, 0),
			RightHip = ang(rad(52), 0, 0),
			RightKnee = ang(rad(-88), 0, 0),
			LeftHip = ang(rad(38), 0, 0),
			LeftKnee = ang(rad(-72), 0, 0),
		}, 0.95, 22)
	end)

	task.delay(0.31, function()
		if State.Mode ~= "WebZipping" then return end
		local preserveVel = zipDir * 80 + v3(0, 22, 0)
		CancelAll()
		if Root then Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = preserveVel end
	end)
end

local function WebShoot()
	if not Root or not Hum or Hum.Health <= 0 or not CheckCooldown("WebShoot") then return end
	local wrist, isRight = NextWrist()
	local startPos = wrist and wrist.WorldPosition or (Root.Position + v3(0, 1.5, 0))
	local cam = Camera.CFrame
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(cam.Position, cam.LookVector * 220, RayParams())
	local endPos = hit and hit.Position or (cam.Position + cam.LookVector * 180)
	local dir = (endPos - startPos).Unit

	if State.Mode == "Idle" then
		local flat = v3(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Root.Position, Root.Position + flat) end
	end

	ActionPose({
		Waist = ang(rad(-6), rad(isRight and 18 or -18), 0),
		RightShoulder = isRight and ang(rad(92), rad(-8), rad(6)) or ang(rad(-15), 0, rad(12)),
		RightWrist = isRight and ang(rad(-28), 0, 0) or CFrame.identity,
		LeftShoulder = (not isRight) and ang(rad(92), rad(8), rad(-6)) or ang(rad(-15), 0, rad(-12)),
		LeftWrist = (not isRight) and ang(rad(-28), 0, 0) or CFrame.identity,
	}, 0.24, 28)

	EmitWebFlash(wrist)
	PlaySFX(isRight and "WEB_SHOOT" or "WEB_SHOOT_ALT", 0.68, 1.08)

	local bullet = Instance.new("Part")
	bullet.Anchored = true
	bullet.CanCollide = false
	bullet.CanQuery = false
	bullet.CanTouch = false
	bullet.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	bullet.Color = CFG.Colors.White
	bullet.Size = v3(0.28, 0.28, 1.3)
	bullet.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(startPos, endPos)
	bullet.Parent = GetFXFolder()

	local att = Instance.new("Attachment", bullet)
	local tether = Instance.new("Beam", bullet)
	StyleWebBeam(tether, 0.07, 0.13, 0.6)
	tether.Attachment0 = wrist
	tether.Attachment1 = att

	local t = clamp((endPos - startPos).Magnitude / 270, 0.05, 0.38)
	TweenService:Create(bullet, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(endPos, endPos + dir) }):Play()
	task.delay(t, function()
		if hit and hit.Instance then
			SpawnWebSplat(hit.Position, hit.Normal, true)
			PlaySFX("IMPACT", 0.42, 1.45)
			if hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") and not hit.Instance.Anchored then
				pcall(function()
					hit.Instance:ApplyImpulseAtPosition(dir * hit.Instance.AssemblyMass * 34, hit.Position)
				end)
			end
		end
		DestroyLater(bullet, 0)
	end)
end

local function WebBomb()
	if not Root or not Hum or Hum.Health <= 0 or not CheckCooldown("WebBomb") then return end
	ActionPose({
		Waist = ang(rad(-16), rad(28), 0),
		RightShoulder = ang(rad(135), 0, rad(20)),
		RightElbow = ang(rad(35), 0, 0),
	}, 0.3, 24)
	PlaySFX("SWOOSH", 0.7, 1.15)

	local folder = GetFXFolder()
	local startPos = Root.Position + v3(0, 2.2, 0) + Camera.CFrame.LookVector * 2
	local vel = (Camera.CFrame.LookVector + v3(0, 0.18, 0)).Unit * 115

	local bomb = Instance.new("Part")
	bomb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	bomb.Anchored = true
	bomb.CanCollide = false
	bomb.CanQuery = false
	bomb.CanTouch = false

	bomb.Parent = folder

	task.spawn(function()
		local pos = startPos
		local p = RayParams()
		local t = 0
		while t < 1.5 and bomb.Parent do
			local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			t += dt
			vel += v3(0, -110 * dt, 0)
			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(pos, vel * dt, p)
			if hit then
				pos = hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.4
				break
			end
			pos += vel * dt
			bomb.Position = pos
		end
		DestroyLater(bomb, 0)

		PlaySFX("WEB_SHOOT_ALT", 0.85, 0.72)
		PlaySFX("IMPACT", 0.8, 1.05)
		CamState.Shake = 0.45
		Shockwave(pos, 26, CFG.Colors.White)

		core.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		core.Anchored = true
		core.CanCollide = false
		core.CanQuery = false
		core.CanTouch = false
		core.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
		core.Color = CFG.Colors.White
		core.Transparency = 0.15
		core.Size = v3(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
		core.Position = pos
		core.Parent = folder
		local cAtt = Instance.new("Attachment", core)

			Size = v3(22, 22, 22), Transparency = 0.9
		}):Play()

		for i = 1, 12 do
			local phi = math.acos(1 - 2 * (i / 12))
			local theta = pi * (1 + 5 ^ 0.5) * i
			local d = v3(cos(theta) * sin(phi), abs(cos(phi)) * 0.6 - 0.25, sin(theta) * sin(phi)).Unit
			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(pos, d * 24, p)
			local endP = hit and hit.Position or (pos + d * 15)
			ShootAnimatedWebLine(cAtt, endP, 4.0)
			if hit then SpawnWebSplat(hit.Position, hit.Normal, true) end
		end
		DestroyLater(core, 4.1)
	end)
end

local function Acrobatics()
	if not Root or not Hum or Hum.Health <= 0 or not CheckCooldown("Acrobatics") then return end
	if State.Mode == "Swinging" then ReleaseSwing(true)
	elseif State.Mode == "Crawling" then StopCrawl(true); return end

	local dir = MoveDir()
	if Hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * 44 + v3(0, 62, 0)
	elseif not State.DoubleJumped then
		State.DoubleJumped = true
		local vel = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = v3(vel.X * 0.8 + dir.X * 26, max(vel.Y, 48), vel.Z * 0.8 + dir.Z * 26)
	end
	PlaySFX("SWOOSH", 0.72, 1.15)

	local fn = functionAcroPoses[State.AcroIdx]
	State.AcroIdx = (State.AcroIdx % #functionAcroPoses) + 1

	local t0 = os.clock()
	local conn: RBXScriptConnection?
	conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local el = os.clock() - t0
		if el >= 0.5 or State.Mode ~= "Idle" then
			if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
			SetPose({}, 0, 16)
			return
		end
		SetPose(fn((el / 0.5) * pi * 2), 1.0, 30)
	end)
end

local function CombatStrike()
	if not Root or not Hum or Hum.Health <= 0 or State.Mode ~= "Idle" or not CheckCooldown("Combat") then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - State.LastCombat > 1.3 then State.Combo = 1 end
	State.LastCombat = now

	local idx = State.Combo
	State.Combo = (State.Combo % 4) + 1

	local flatLook = v3(Camera.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, Camera.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.05 then Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Root.Position, Root.Position + flatLook.Unit) end

	local fwd = Root.CFrame.LookVector
	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += fwd * 22 + (idx == 4 and v3(0, 34, 0) or Vector3.zero)
	PlaySFX("SWOOSH", 0.68, 0.95 + idx * 0.08)
	ActionPose(COMBAT_POSES[idx], 0.32, 28)

	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, fwd * 6.5, RayParams())
	if hit and hit.Instance then
		PlaySFX("IMPACT", 0.72, 1.05 + idx * 0.05)
		CamState.Shake = 0.22
		SpawnWebSplat(hit.Position, hit.Normal, false)
		Shockwave(hit.Position, 6 + idx * 1.5, CFG.Colors.Cyan)
		if hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") and not hit.Instance.Anchored then
			pcall(function()
				hit.Instance:ApplyImpulseAtPosition((fwd + v3(0, 0.35, 0)).Unit * hit.Instance.AssemblyMass * (38 + idx * 12), hit.Position)
			end)
		end
	end
end

	if not Root or not Hum or Hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	local pos = Root.Position
	local danger = false
	local dir = Vector3.zero

	local vel = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if vel.Magnitude > 70 and State.Mode == "Idle" then
		local hit = Workspace:Raycast(pos, vel.Unit * 22, RayParams())
		if hit then danger = true; dir = (hit.Position - pos).Unit end
	end

	State.Threat = danger
	State.ThreatDir = dir

	local head = Parts["Head"]
	if not head then return end
	local show = danger or State.SenseActive
	if not show then
		if UI.Crown then DestroyLater(UI.Crown, 0); UI.Crown = nil end
		return
	end

	if not UI.Crown or not UI.Crown.Parent then
		local m = Instance.new("Model", GetFXFolder())
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local b = Instance.new("Part", m)
			b.Name = "B" .. i
			b.Anchored = true
			b.CanCollide = false
			b.CanQuery = false
			b.CanTouch = false
			b.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			b.Size = v3(0.11, 0.11, 1.3)
		end
		UI.Crown = m
	end

	local t = os.clock() * 25
	for i, b in ipairs(UI.Crown:GetChildren()) do
		if b:IsA("BasePart") then
			local a = (i / 8) * pi * 2 + sin(t + i) * 0.05
			local d = v3(cos(a), 0.32 + (i % 2) * 0.2, sin(a)).Unit
			local r = 1.45 + sin(t * 1.5 + i) * 0.2
			b.Color = (i % 2 == 0) and CFG.Colors.Danger or CFG.Colors.White
			b.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(head.Position + d * r, head.Position + d * (r + 1.3))
		end
	end
end

local function MakeDraggable(gui: GuiObject, onTap: (() -> ())?, onHold: ((boolean) -> ())?)
	local dragging, moved = false, false
	local dragInput: InputObject?
	local startPos = Vector2.zero
	local startGuiPos = gui.Position

	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging, moved = true, false
			startPos = Vector2.new(inp.Position.X, inp.Position.Y)
			startGuiPos = gui.Position
			if onHold then onHold(true) end

			local c: RBXScriptConnection?
			c = inp.Changed:Connect(function()
				if inp.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					if c then c:Disconnect() end
					if not dragging then return end
					dragging = false
					if onHold then onHold(false) end
					if not moved and onTap then onTap() end
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = inp
		end
	end)

	table.insert(State.Conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp == dragInput and dragging then
			local delta = Vector2.new(inp.Position.X, inp.Position.Y) - startPos
			if delta.Magnitude > 16 then
				if not moved then
					moved = true
					if onHold then onHold(false) end
				end
				gui.Position = UDim2.new(startGuiPos.X.Scale, startGuiPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startGuiPos.Y.Scale, startGuiPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
			end
		end
	end))
end
